The following picture shows the current state of all supported elements:

  • Green: Supported
  • White: Planned for future version
  • Red: Will not be supported

Look in the subsections for a detailed overview of all supported elements.

The following concepts are currently not (yet) supported:

  • Execution listeners. At this time we believe that this is a concept that should be avoided. It hides complexity and would give a significant performance impact if used. The current implementation of TaktX already allows you to listen to the event stream of everything that happens. The only thing that is not possible is to manipulate variables.
  • DMN Support. Planned for a future release.
  • Connector runtime framework. Planned for a future release.
  • Binding; currently the binding parameter, for example for configuring Call Activities is ignored. The last deployed version is always selected.

So when using the Camunda Desktop Modeler make sure to not use these features.
